attributes.title: Leaked data

attributes.description: One row per ingest run (ingest.py's index_run_summary, item 25) - the reconciliation counts that were previously only printed to the container's own log.
attributes.title: Ingest run history

attributes.description: Documents where at least one personal identifier was found by 'deis pii-scan' (item 31/48): Swedish personnummer/samordningsnummer (shown normalized to 12 digits), organisationsnummer, bankgiro/plusgiro, Norwegian fødselsnummer, Finnish henkilötunnus, IBAN, card number - each checksum-validated - plus emails, phone numbers and Danish CPR (shape only).
attributes.title: Documents with personal identifiers

attributes.description: Text OCR'd from image files by unpack's maybe_ocr (item 21) - the original image had no extractable text of its own, so this is a separate document containing what Tesseract read from it.
attributes.title: OCR-extracted text

attributes.description: Documents grouped into near-duplicate clusters by 'deis dedupe-scan' (item 33) - mail threads, template letters, and versioned files that share most of their content without being byte-identical (exact sha256 dedup, item 41, only catches identical files). Sort by duplicate_cluster to see each cluster's members together.
attributes.title: Near-duplicate clusters

attributes.description: Item 21's structured-data-as-rows piece: one document per CSV row (source_filename/row_number/row, row's columns via a 'flattened' field) rather than the whole file's flattened text blob, so a precise per-column query becomes possible. .csv only for now.
attributes.title: CSV rows

attributes.description: Documents where at least one named entity (item 32: person, organization, or location - spaCy NER, English/Swedish) was found by 'deis entity-scan'.
attributes.title: Documents with named entities

attributes.description: Documents with a known provenance chain (item 46) - the original download URL, and every archive they were nested inside, root to leaf, from 'deis run'/'deis add-files'. A document with no known origin (added before this feature existed, or via add-files with no live URL) has an empty source_chain.url and won't match.
attributes.title: Documents with known provenance

attributes.description: Documents where at least one person was named (item 36: a saved search per detected entity type, narrower than the combined 'Documents with named entities' search).
attributes.title: Documents with named persons

attributes.description: Documents where at least one organization was named (item 36: a saved search per detected entity type, narrower than the combined 'Documents with named entities' search).
attributes.title: Documents with named organizations

attributes.description: Documents where at least one location was named (item 36: a saved search per detected entity type, narrower than the combined 'Documents with named entities' search).
attributes.title: Documents with named locations

attributes.description: GPS coordinates extracted from JPEG EXIF data (deis geo-scan) - points where a phone/camera photo in this corpus was taken.

attributes.description: Documents where 'deis secret-scan' found a private key, API/cloud token, JWT, credential-bearing URL, or a password assignment. Leads, not proof - password_assignments in particular are unvalidated.
attributes.title: Documents with credentials

attributes.description: Documents where 'deis secret-scan' found IP addresses, UNC paths, usernames from home-directory paths, hostnames, .onion addresses or checksum-valid Bitcoin addresses.
attributes.title: Documents with infrastructure artifacts

attributes.description: Files ingest classified by magic number, name or extension as credential stores, key material, secrets-bearing config, remote-access configs, executables, disk images, databases or ransom notes (sensitive_class).
attributes.title: Sensitive files

attributes.description: Files whose name or opening text looks like a ransomware note - the group's own words, payment address and contact details usually live here.
attributes.title: Ransom notes

attributes.description: RFC 822 messages (.eml, mbox messages, readpst output) with their parsed sender, recipients, subject, date and attachment names (item 50).
attributes.title: Email messages

attributes.description: Documents whose Tika-extracted text hit their indexed_chars cap - the rest of the document is NOT searchable. Raise indexed_chars/indexed_chars_pdf in deis.cfg and re-ingest if these matter.
attributes.title: Truncated documents

attributes.description: Files whose extension disagrees with what Tika detected the content to be - renamed, disguised, or just mislabelled.
attributes.title: Extension does not match content

attributes.description: JPEGs whose EXIF data named the camera/phone, the software that wrote the file, or when the shutter fired (deis geo-scan).
attributes.title: Photos with camera metadata
